import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(port))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I, O = 8, 12
    W = torch.randn(O, I); x = torch.randn(3, 5, I)
    for cls, dim in [(ColumnParallelLinear, 0), (RowParallelLinear, 1)]:
        m = cls(I, O, True, W.clone())
        ref = torch.nn.Linear(I, O); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
        xa = x.clone().requires_grad_(); xb = x.clone().requires_grad_()
        y = m(xa); yr = ref(xb)
        assert torch.allclose(y, yr, atol=1e-5), cls
        (y**2).sum().backward(); (yr**2).sum().backward()
        c = W.shape[dim] // ws
        gw = ref.weight.grad.narrow(dim, rank*c, c)
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, gw, atol=1e-4), cls
        gb = ref.bias.grad.narrow(0, rank*(O//ws), O//ws) if dim == 0 else ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, gb, atol=1e-4), cls
        assert torch.allclose(xa.grad, xb.grad, atol=1e-4), cls
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for i, ws in enumerate([1, 2, 4]):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws, 29600+i), nprocs=ws); print("ok", ws)
